$comment: Interactive hit areas for the owner-supplied master isometric overview. Polygons are hand-traced on zoomed crops of the original and stored in NORMALIZED source-image coordinates. Artwork/pin/index numbers are NOT official LPU block numbers. Nothing here names, numbers or positions a real building on the geographic map. DRAFT for owner review.

coordinateSystem.origin: top-left of the original image; x right, y down; pixel edges (a pixel centre is at (i + 0.5) / size)
coordinateSystem.polygons: Simple polygons, open rings (first vertex not repeated), clockwise on screen (y down).
coordinateSystem.pinRadius: rx = radius / sourceWidth, ry = radius / sourceHeight (the printed disc is circular in source pixels).
coordinateSystem.transform: Render the image and these outlines with ONE shared transform: screen = translate + scale * (n * [sourceWidth, sourceHeight]). Never fit them separately.

kinds.pin-structure: the drawn structure the numbered overview pin sits on
kinds.unassigned-structure: part of a pinned complex that is not under any pin; candidatePinNumbers lists the pins of that complex
kinds.unpinned-structure: structure with no overview pin; a vignette draws a pin there (visual correspondence only)
kinds.scene: unlabelled drawn feature that a scene vignette shows (visual correspondence only); no name is printed on the overview
kinds.printed-text: legible text printed inside the map area

conventions.artworkLabel: Exactly what is printed on the overview for this hotspot (pin digits or printed text); null when nothing is printed. Never corrected.
conventions.labelAnchor: Interior point of the polygon farthest from its edges, for placing a label or focus ring.
conventions.pin: The printed disc (centre + radii). Discs have no pointer tail, so the anchor is the disc centre; a disc does not mark an exact ground point and may overhang the outline.

confidence.high: outline clearly bounded in the drawing
confidence.medium: outline clear but extent or part of a boundary judged
confidence.low: boundary with neighbours or the pin assignment is judged

reviewStatus.traced: traced and checked on zoomed overlays
reviewStatus.needs-manual-verification: ambiguous outline or assignment; owner should confirm before relying on it

conventions.links: indexRows and vignettes reference label/asset ids in inventory.json. Vignette relations: caption-heading(-and-pin) = the vignette caption heading names this number; pin-drawn-in-scene = the number appears only as a pin in a scene vignette; caption-covers-candidate-number = an unassigned part of a complex whose caption covers that number; vignette-pin-visual-correspondence / scene-visual-correspondence = matched by eye between two drawings, needs manual verification.

qa.method: Pin discs found by an automated white-disc scan of the original (45 discs, each within 3.6 px of the inventory pin centre) and read at 4x. Outlines traced in source pixels on 2.6x-8x gridded crops, normalised, then re-rendered over the original at 0.5x-5x and inspected.
